segments.mn87:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn87:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa gahapatissa ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālaṅkato hoti.
segments.mn87:2.2: Tassa kālaṃkiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
segments.mn87:3.1: Atha kho so gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.mn87:3.2: “na kho te, gahapati, sake citte ṭhitassa indriyāni, atthi te indriyānaṃ aññathattan”ti.
segments.mn87:3.4: mayhañhi, bhante, ekaputto piyo manāpo kālaṅkato.
segments.mn87:3.5: Tassa kālaṃkiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
segments.mn87:3.8: “Evametaṃ, gahapati, evametaṃ, gahapati [evametaṃ gahapati (pī. sakideva), evameva (sī. sakideva)]!
segments.mn87:3.10: “Kassa kho [kissa nu kho (sī.)] nāmetaṃ, bhante, evaṃ bhavissati –
segments.mn87:3.12: Piyajātikā hi kho, bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikā”ti.
segments.mn87:3.13: Atha kho so gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ anabhinanditvā paṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.mn87:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā akkhadhuttā bhagavato avidūre akkhehi dibbanti.
segments.mn87:4.2: Atha kho so gahapati yena te akkhadhuttā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā akkhadhutte etadavoca –
segments.mn87:4.3: “idhāhaṃ, bhonto, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho maṃ, bhonto, samaṇo gotamo etadavoca –
segments.mn87:4.4: ‘na kho te, gahapati, sake citte ṭhitassa indriyāni, atthi te indriyānaṃ aññathattan’ti.
segments.mn87:4.5: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhonto, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn87:4.7: mayhañhi, bhante, ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālaṅkato.
segments.mn87:4.8: Tassa kālaṃkiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
segments.mn87:4.9: Sohaṃ āḷāhanaṃ gantvā kandāmi – kahaṃ, ekaputtaka, kahaṃ, ekaputtakā’ti!
segments.mn87:4.13: ‘Kassa kho nāmetaṃ, bhante, evaṃ bhavissati – piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā?
segments.mn87:4.15: Piyajātikā hi kho, bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikā’ti.
segments.mn87:4.16: Atha khvāhaṃ, bhonto, samaṇassa gotamassa bhāsitaṃ anabhinanditvā paṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamin”ti.
segments.mn87:4.19: Atha kho so gahapati “sameti me akkhadhuttehī”ti pakkāmi.
segments.mn87:5.1: Atha kho idaṃ kathāvatthu anupubbena rājantepuraṃ pāvisi.
segments.mn87:5.2: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn87:5.6: “Evameva panāyaṃ mallikā yaññadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati taṃ tadevassa abbhanumodati”.
segments.mn87:5.8: Seyyathāpi nāma, yaññadeva ācariyo antevāsissa bhāsati taṃ tadevassa antevāsī abbhanumodati –
segments.mn87:5.10: “Evameva kho tvaṃ, mallike, yaññadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati taṃ tadevassa abbhanumodasi”.
segments.mn87:6.1: Atha kho mallikā devī nāḷijaṅghaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn87:6.2: “ehi tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha –
segments.mn87:6.3: ‘mallikā, bhante, devī bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
segments.mn87:6.5: ‘bhāsitā nu kho, bhante, bhagavatā esā vācā – piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’ti.
segments.mn87:6.7: Yathā te bhagavā byākaroti taṃ sādhukaṃ uggahetvā mama āroceyyāsi.
segments.mn87:6.9: “Evaṃ, bhotī”ti kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo mallikāya deviyā paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn87:6.10: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn87:6.11: “mallikā, bho gotama, devī bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati; appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati;
segments.mn87:6.13: ‘bhāsitā nu kho, bhante, bhagavatā esā vācā – piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’”ti.
segments.mn87:8.1: Tadamināpetaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā.
segments.mn87:8.2: Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarissā itthiyā mātā kālamakāsi.
segments.mn87:8.3: Sā tassā kālakiriyāya ummattikā khittacittā rathikāya rathikaṃ [rathiyāya rathiyaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha –
segments.mn87:8.4: ‘api me mātaraṃ addassatha [addasatha (sī. pī.)], api me mātaraṃ addassathā’ti?
segments.mn87:9-14.1: Imināpi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
segments.mn87:9-14.2: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarissā itthiyā pitā kālamakāsi … bhātā kālamakāsi … bhaginī kālamakāsi … putto kālamakāsi … dhītā kālamakāsi … sāmiko kālamakāsi.
segments.mn87:9-14.8: Sā tassa kālakiriyāya ummattikā khittacittā rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha –
segments.mn87:9-14.9: ‘api me sāmikaṃ addassatha, api me sāmikaṃ addassathā’ti?
segments.mn87:15-21.1: Imināpi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
segments.mn87:15-21.2: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassa purisassa mātā kālamakāsi.
segments.mn87:15-21.3: So tassā kālakiriyāya ummattako khittacitto rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha –
segments.mn87:15-21.4: ‘api me mātaraṃ addassatha, api me mātaraṃ addassathā’ti?
segments.mn87:15-21.5: Imināpi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
segments.mn87:15-21.6: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassa purisassa pitā kālamakāsi … bhātā kālamakāsi … bhaginī kālamakāsi … putto kālamakāsi … dhītā kālamakāsi … pajāpati kālamakāsi.
segments.mn87:15-21.12: So tassā kālakiriyāya ummattako khittacitto rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha –
segments.mn87:15-21.13: ‘api me pajāpatiṃ addassatha, api me pajāpatiṃ addassathā’ti?
segments.mn87:15-21.14: Imināpi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
segments.mn87:22.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarā itthī ñātikulaṃ agamāsi.
segments.mn87:22.2: Tassā te ñātakā sāmikaṃ [sāmikā (sī.)] acchinditvā aññassa dātukāmā.
segments.mn87:22.4: Atha kho sā itthī sāmikaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn87:22.5: ‘ime, maṃ [mama (syā. kaṃ. pī.)], ayyaputta, ñātakā tvaṃ [tayā (sī.), taṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] acchinditvā aññassa dātukāmā.
segments.mn87:22.7: Atha kho so puriso taṃ itthiṃ dvidhā chetvā attānaṃ upphālesi [uppāṭesi (sī. pī.), ophāresi (ka.)]–
segments.mn87:22.9: Imināpi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā”ti.
segments.mn87:23.1: Atha kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena mallikā devī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā yāvatako ahosi bhagavatā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ mallikāya deviyā ārocesi. Atha kho mallikā devī yena rājā pasenadi kosalo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn87:24.1: “taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te vajirī kumārī”ti?
segments.mn87:24.4: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, vajiriyā te kumāriyā vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:24.6: “Vajiriyā me, mallike, kumāriyā vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:24.7: “Idaṃ kho taṃ, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.mn87:25.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te vāsabhā khattiyā”ti?
segments.mn87:25.4: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, vāsabhāya te khattiyāya vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:25.5: “Vāsabhāya me, mallike, khattiyāya vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:25.6: “Idaṃ kho taṃ, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.mn87:26.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyo te viṭaṭūbho [viḍūḍabho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] senāpatī”ti?
segments.mn87:26.3: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, viṭaṭūbhassa te senāpatissa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:26.4: “Viṭaṭūbhassa me, mallike, senāpatissa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:26.5: “Idaṃ kho taṃ, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.mn87:27.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te ahan”ti?
segments.mn87:27.3: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, mayhaṃ te vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:27.5: “Tuyhañhi me, mallike, vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:27.6: “Idaṃ kho taṃ, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.mn87:28.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te kāsikosalā”ti?
segments.mn87:28.4: Kāsikosalānaṃ, mallike, ānubhāvena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhoma, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāremā”ti.
segments.mn87:28.5: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, kāsikosalānaṃ te vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:28.7: “Kāsikosalānañhi, mallike, vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.mn87:28.8: “Idaṃ kho taṃ, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.mn87:29.2: Yāvañca so bhagavā paññāya ativijjha maññe [paṭivijjha paññāya (ka.)] passati.
segments.mn87:29.4: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi –
segments.mn87:29.5: “namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa, namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa, namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassā”ti.

lines: Evaṃ me sutanti piyajātikasuttaṃ.
Tattha neva kammantā paṭibhantīti na sabbena sabbaṃ paṭibhanti, pakatiniyāmena pana na paṭibhanti.
Dutiyapadepi eseva nayo.
Ettha ca na paṭibhātīti na ruccati.
Āḷāhananti susānaṃ.
Aññathattanti vivaṇṇatāya aññathābhāvo.
Indriyāni nāma manoviññeyyā dhammā, patiṭṭhitokāsaṃ pana sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ.
Piyajātikāti piyato jāyanti.
Piyappabhāvikāti piyato pabhavanti.
Sace taṃ, mahārājāti tassa atthaṃ asallakkhayamānāpi satthari saddhāya evaṃ vadati.
Cara pireti apehi amhākaṃ pare, anajjhattikabhūteti attho.
Atha vā cara pireti parato gaccha, mā idha tiṭṭhātipi attho.
Dvidhā chetvāti asinā dve koṭṭhāse karonto chinditvā.
Attānaṃ upphālesīti teneva asinā attano udaraṃ phālesi.
Yadi hi tassa sā appiyā bhaveyya, idāni aññaṃ mātugāmaṃ gaṇhissāmīti attānaṃ na ghāteyya.
Yasmā panassa sā piyā ahosi, tasmā paralokepi tāya saddhiṃ samaṅgibhāvaṃ patthayamāno evamakāsi.
Piyā te vajirīti evaṃ kirassā ahosi –

“sacāhaṃ,‘bhūtapubbaṃ, mahārāja, imissāyeva sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarissā itthiyā’tiādikathaṃ katheyyaṃ,‘ko te evaṃ akāsi, apehi natthi etan’ti maṃ paṭisedheyya, vattamāneneva naṃ saññāpessāmī”ti cintetvā evamāha.
Vipariṇāmaññathābhāvāti ettha maraṇavasena vipariṇāmo, kenaci saddhiṃ palāyitvā gamanavasena aññathābhāvo veditabbo.
Vāsabhāyāti vāsabhā nāma rañño ekā devī, taṃ sandhāyāha.
Piyā te ahanti kasmā sabbapacchā āha?
Evaṃ kirassā ahosi –

“ayaṃ rājā mayhaṃ kupito, sacāhaṃ sabbapaṭhamaṃ ‘piyā te ahan’ti puccheyyaṃ,‘na me tvaṃ piyā, cara pire’ti vadeyya, evaṃ sante kathā patiṭṭhānaṃ na labhissatī”ti kathāya patiṭṭhānatthaṃ sabbapacchā pucchi.
Kāsikosalesu chaḍḍitabhāvena vipariṇāmo, paṭirājūnaṃ hatthagamanavasena aññathābhāvo veditabbo.
Ācamehīti ācamanodakaṃ dehi.
Ācamitvā hatthapāde dhovitvā mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā satthāraṃ namassitukāmo evamāha.
Sesaṃ sabbattha uttānamevāti.
Pakatiniyāmenāti yathā sokuppattito pubbe iti kattabbesu asammohavasena cittaṃ pakkhandati, tāni cassa upaṭṭhahanti, na evaṃ sokassa cittasaṅkocasabhāvato.
Tena vuttaṃ “pakatiniyāmena pana na paṭibhantī”ti.
Keci pana “sāmantā katipaye na kuṭumbaṃ sandhāreti.
Tenāha ‘na sabbena sabbaṃ paṭibhantī’ti” vadanti.
Etthāti dutiyapade.
Anekatthattā dhātūnaṃ “na paṭibhātī”ti padassa “na ruccatī”ti atthamāha.
Na paṭibhātīti vā bhuñjitukāmatācittaṃ na upaṭṭhitanti attho.
Patiṭṭhitokāsanti indriyāviṭṭhaṭṭhānaṃ vadati.
Piyāyitabbato piyo jāti uppattiṭṭhānaṃ etesanti piyajātikā.
Piyo pabhuti etesanti piyappabhutikāti vattabbe, u-kārassa va-kāraṃ, ta-kārassa ca lopaṃ katvā “piyappabhāvikā”ti vuttaṃ.
Tenāha “piyato pabhavantī”ti.
Para-saddena samānatthaṃ ajjhattikabhāvanisedhanatthaṃ “pire”ti padanti āha “amhākaṃ pare”ti.
Pireti vā “parato”ti iminā samānatthaṃ nipātapadanti āha “cara pireti parato gacchā”ti.
Dvidhā chetvāti ettha yadi itthī tassa purisassa piyā, kathaṃ dvidhā chindatīti āha “yadi hī”tiādi.
Kathaṃ katheyyanti yathā bhagavā etassa brāhmaṇassa kathesi, so ca me kathesi, tathā cāhaṃ katheyyaṃ.
Maraṇavasena vipariṇāmo attabhāvassa parivattattā.
Palāyitvā gamanavasena aññathābhāvo mittasanthavassa samāgamassa ca aññathābhūtattā.
Chaḍḍitabhāvenāti parivattitabhāvena.
Hatthagamanavasena aññathābhāvo pubbe savase vattitānaṃ idāni vase avattanabhāvena.
Ācamehīti ācamanaṃ mukhavikkhālanaṃ kārehi.
Yasmā mukhaṃ vikkhālentā hi hatthapāde dhovitvā vikkhālenti, tasmā “ācamitvā”ti vatvā pacchāpi tassa atthaṃ dassento “mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā”ti āha.
Sesaṃ suviññeyyameva.
